events.title: Stay of District Court Orders in Department of State v. AIDS Vaccine Advocacy Coalition
events.summary: The Supreme Court, through Chief Justice John G. Roberts, Jr., issued an order staying the February 25, 2025 orders of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia in the cases numbered 1:25-cv-00400 and 1:25-cv-00402. This stay is pending further order from the Chief Justice or the Court. The order also requires any response to the application to be filed by February 28, 2025, at 12 p.m. EST.
events.why_relevant: The stay affects the enforcement of lower court decisions, impacting the legal proceedings and potential outcomes in these cases.
